subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers review/adopt the open external fork PR for this issue, replace it with a narrow upstream PR, or wait for the contributor to refresh it?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and small, but an open linked fork PR already owns the patch shape, so automation should not queue duplicate work without maintainer direction.

options.title: Review or Adopt Fork PR
options.body: Review the external patch and, if it still fits current main, adopt or land an equivalent upstream change so this issue can close after merge.

options.title: Replace With Upstream PR
options.body: Open a focused upstream PR that only normalizes the shared label helper and adds regression coverage if the fork branch is not usable.

options.title: Wait for Contributor Refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open with the fork PR as the active candidate if maintainers want the contributor to refresh it first.

recommendation.title: Review or Adopt Fork PR
recommendation.body: Review the external patch and, if it still fits current main, adopt or land an equivalent upstream change so this issue can close after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior ClawSweeper routing and recent adjacent history point to this account as the best available maintainer-side decision owner for adopting or replacing the fork PR.
